Don’t lose this list

On iPhone: tap Share → Add to Home Screen to keep it next to your other apps.

What each home gets

  • Rent check — what new leases in that postcode actually went for, by bedrooms, from every NSW rental bond. Enter the asking rent to see if it’s above or below the middle.
  • Flood and bush fire — NSW Planning Portal hazard layers for that exact address.
  • Zoning — what can be built there, and next door.
  • Aircraft noise — Western Sydney Airport contours (Sydney Airport coming).
  • Tree canopy — share of the area under trees.
  • 3D walk — when SHOWHAUS has one for that home.

Sources are named on every card. Nothing is fetched from the listing site — we only read the address from the link you paste.
